# chronosphere_metric_name_default_active_series_limit (Resource)

Singleton per-tenant default cap on the number of active time series accepted for each metric name over the active time series rolling window.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "chronosphere_metric_name_default_active_series_limit" "default" {
  default_max_active_standard_series  = 50000
  default_max_active_histogram_series = 5000
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `default_max_active_histogram_series` (Number) The default active histogram time series allowed for each metric name over the active time series rolling window. If zero or unset, the Chronosphere-managed default limit is used. A `chronosphere_metric_name_active_series_limit` overrides this default for its metric name. Can't exceed the Chronosphere-managed default limit.
- `default_max_active_standard_series` (Number) The default active standard (non-histogram) time series allowed for each metric name over the active time series rolling window. If zero or unset, the Chronosphere-managed default limit is used. A `chronosphere_metric_name_active_series_limit` overrides this default for its metric name. Can't exceed the Chronosphere-managed default limit.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
